conversation.contentPreview:
Create a complete single self-contained file `chip8_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html` (HTML + CSS + JavaScript inline;
no external libraries, CDNs, assets or backend). Build a working CHIP-8 emulator.

Implement the interpreter properly: 4 KB of memory with the font set loaded at 0x050 and programs at 0x200,
sixteen 8-bit registers V0 to VF, the 16-bit index register, the program counter, a call stack, and the
delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz. Decode and execute the complete instruction set of 35
instructions, including the arithmetic and logic group with the carry and borrow flags in VF, the shift
instructions, jumps and calls, the random instruction, BCD conversion, register save and load, and the key
tests.

The display is 64 by 32 pixels drawn on a canvas scaled to a readable size, with sprites drawn by XOR and
the collision flag set in VF. The 16-key keypad is mapped to a 4 by 4 block of keyboard keys shown in the
interface; key press and release must both reach the emulator.

Include a small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file: a real program, assembled by you, that draws a
sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

Add run, pause, single step and reset controls, an adjustable instructions-per-frame speed, and a debugger
panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html`.

Strict matching of suffixes. Capture source operands before writing VF so x or y=F math/shifts/draw is correct. 8xy4 VF=carry, 8xy5 VF=(oldVx>=oldVy), 8xy7 VF=(oldVy>=oldVx); shifts use Vx, VF shifted-out bit; logic preserves VF except naturally x=F; Bnnn=nnn+V0; I adds masked16bit without VF change; Fx55/Fx65 leave I unchanged; Fx29 lowest hex nibble; random full0..255 AND kk. XOR draw wraps x/y and sprite pixels at screen edges; clear VF then set on collision with old coordinates captured; bounds-check sprite memory before writes. Document this modern quirk profile in UI. A compatibility checkbox for original Vy shifts and increment I on transfer is optional but avoid unnecessary controls.

Pointerdown/up/cancel/lost capture and keyboard both maintain independent sources per CHIP key so release of one doesn't unset another; active styles and aria-pressed update. Blur/hidden clears all input and pauses to prevent stuck keys/background time jumps. Fx0A waits for a fresh press (no busy infinite loop): instruction records waiting register and pc has advanced; cycles suspend while waiting but timers run; fresh down supplies V register then clears wait. Avoid huge CPU catchup while blocked; debugger explicitly shows waiting.
Timing: requestAnimationFrame accumulator fixed 1000/60 ticks independent of instruction speed: each tick execute speed instructions unless paused/fault/wait; decrement dt and st once per tick while running, including wait. Cap elapsed/catchup to avoid spiral; paused freezes timers, step does not fast-forward timers. Frame rendering and debugger throttled (e.g. 10Hz except force on state changes), display dirty redraw. Sound WebAudio square oscillator through gain only st>0 AND running AND enabled. Initialize/resume only user gesture, catch missing/blocked audio, toggle updates label/state, pause/reset stops gain. Keep single raf loop. No external libraries.
Demo MUST be real embedded explicit byte array with comments/address map, manually assembled. Explanation: 0x200 CLS, set V0=30 V1=14 I=0x23C draw 5-row ship; at0x20A set V2=2 dt=2;0x20E poll dt until0;0x214 erase; 4/6 keys move horizontal,8/2 vertical via key-skip,5 sets sound;0x238 draw;0x23A jump0x20A; sprite0x23C. Physical Q/E W/S move, physical R beep, clearly show controls in UI. Demo loop erases/redraws via XOR and paced by DT. Include demo byte array exactly, not a JS animation disguised as emulation.
Decoded current instruction human-readable for every opcode with correct invalid labeling; show opcode+address, waiting state separate, stack and timers and cycle total; textContent safe for filenames and errors.
